LAFFEY_SPIRE2_CARD_BARRAGE.title: Barrage
LAFFEY_SPIRE2_CARD_BARRAGE.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to random enemies {Repeat:diff()} times.
LAFFEY_SPIRE2_CARD_DROWSY_STRIKE.title: Drowsy Strike
LAFFEY_SPIRE2_CARD_DROWSY_STRIKE.descrip: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Next turn, draw 1 fewer card.
LAFFEY_SPIRE2_CARD_LIGHT_SLEEP.title: Light Sleep
LAFFEY_SPIRE2_CARD_LIGHT_SLEEP.descripti: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. Next turn, draw 1 fewer card.
LAFFEY_SPIRE2_CARD_DAY_NIGHT_BARRAGE.des: At the start and end of your turn, deal {DayNightBarragePower:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
LAFFEY_SPIRE2_CARD_FIGHTING_SPIRIT.title: Fighting Spirit
LAFFEY_SPIRE2_CARD_FIGHTING_SPIRIT.descr:
{IfUpgraded:show:Increase damage you deal by [blue]10%[/blue] immediately.
|}At the start of your turn, increase damage you deal by [blue]10%[/blue].
LAFFEY_SPIRE2_CARD_NIGHT_WATCH_BARRAGE.d: At the end of this turn, deal damage to ALL enemies equal to your current [gold]Block[/gold].
At the start of each turn, lose [blue]1[/blue] Energy. The first card you play each turn is free.
LAFFEY_SPIRE2_CARD_ANNIHILATION_MODE.des:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage {Repeat:diff()} times.
At the start of your turn, if this is in your [gold]Exhaust Pile[/gold], play it.
LAFFEY_SPIRE2_CARD_AWAKENED_FIREPOWER.de: The first Attack you play each turn is [gold]Exhausted[/gold], and you gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
Draw cards until your hand is full.
End your turn.
LAFFEY_SPIRE2_CARD_DREAM_ECHO.title: Dream Echo
LAFFEY_SPIRE2_CARD_DREAM_ECHO.descriptio:
Choose a card in your hand to [gold]Exhaust[/gold].
At the start of each of your next {Turns:diff()} turns, play a copy of it and [gold]Exhaust[/gold] that copy.
LAFFEY_SPIRE2_CARD_DREAM_ECHO.selectionS: Choose a card in your hand to Exhaust.
LAFFEY_SPIRE2_CARD_EMERGENCY_REVEILLE.de: Play every card in your hand, then end your turn.
LAFFEY_SPIRE2_CARD_FINAL_SHOWDOWN.title: Final Showdown
LAFFEY_SPIRE2_CARD_FINAL_SHOWDOWN.descri:
Can only be played on turn [blue]7[/blue] or later.
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
